decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's established geospatial data integration capabilities, was given a dedicated product page, and fits knowledge the firm can readily improve through its existing R&D.

A building data digital twin service extends the firm's core geospatial and enterprise-integration know-how into a growing adjacent use case where its existing expertise and research links should support learning and refinement.

Although related to the offer, authentication and identity delegation is more generic than the firm's geospatial core and shows weaker market traction than the more clearly positioned GIS-specific identity service, so resources are better concentrated elsewhere.

An open GIS application development framework closely matches the firm's long-standing strengths in extensible platforms, software components, and developer-oriented geospatial engineering, making it highly absorptive and strategically useful.

This GIS-focused identity and access service is close to the firm's enterprise-geospatial integration business, had an explicit launch positioning, and can be improved using the firm's existing integration and user-centered development knowledge.
